title: 第8章 忽悠成功
slug: 七天后穿越我提前囤货躲灾年
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“没问题啊！”

谭筝现在租的那个房子，地段、装修哪哪都好，就是太吵，左邻右舍还不好相处。

房主苦不堪言，只能选择挪窝。

在她之前还有五六任租客，都是住进去没几天就跑了。

为了能够把房子租出去，房主只好把价格一降再降，这才让谭筝以一个极低的捡漏价住了进来。

穷都不怕了，还怕啥。

谭筝的睡眠质量不是一般的好，再加上白天都在外面当牛马搬砖，跟邻居们也没什么碰面的机会，所以勉强还算是可以忍受。

她把这些情况详细的给对方描述了一下后，又

“你好，你看看以上这些你能不能接受？如果可以的话，我们约个时间看房吧？”

【对方正在输入中……】

“没问题，完全可以接受，今天已经有些晚了，明天早上八点在小区门口碰面，可以吗？o(=•ェ•=)m”

看对方的头像比较可爱，又爱发颜文字，所以谭筝下意识地认为对面是个妹子，害怕晚上看房不安全。

“当然可以！(•̀ω•́)y”

双方约定好了以后，谭筝收起手机，总觉得自己好像忘记了什么事。

“糟了！我的共享单车没锁！”

谭筝无奈，只能联系人工客服结束订单。

可眼下这鸟不拉屎的地方根本扫不到第二辆单车，时间不等人，她忍痛打了辆车，往南麓茶舍赶去。

潘丽比她想象中的还要心急，时不时就发个消息来催她，生怕这铁饭碗的机会跑了。

谭筝自然不能让她失望，戏台搭好，就等各方登场了。

她这回找的演员，一个叫倪海，45岁，负责扮演领导；另外一个叫周向阳，25岁，负责扮演她的同学；还有一个女孩，叫小娟，负责扮演茶艺师。

“几位老师你们好，大概的剧情我已经事先发给你们了，按照上面的来演就行了，得时刻记清自己的人设，别露出破绽来。”

“没问题。”

简单的寒暄了几句以后，谭筝让演员们先进入雅间，自己则在外头等候。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"No problem!"

The house Tan Zheng is renting now has a good location and decoration, but it is too noisy and the neighbors are not easy to get along with.

The homeowner was miserable and had no choice but to move.

There were five or six tenants before her, but they all left within a few days of moving in.

In order to be able to rent out the house, the landlord had to lower the price again and again, and then Tan Zheng was allowed to move in at an extremely low price.

I’m not afraid of being poor anymore, so what else do I have to be afraid of?

Tan Zheng's sleep quality was not very good. In addition, she worked outside during the day as a cow and horse carrying bricks, and had few opportunities to meet her neighbors, so it was still bearable.

After she described these situations to the other party in detail, she then

"Hello, do you think you can accept the above? If so, can we make an appointment to view the house?"

[The other party is typing...]

"No problem, it's completely acceptable. It's already a little late today. Let's meet at the gate of the community at eight o'clock tomorrow morning, okay? o(=•ェ•=)m"

The other person's avatar looked cute and he liked to send emojis, so Tan Zheng subconsciously thought the other person was a girl and was afraid that it would be unsafe to check out the apartment at night.

"Of course! (•̀ω•́)y"

After the two parties agreed, Tan Zheng put away her phone and felt that she had forgotten something.

"Oops! My shared bike is unlocked!"

Tan Zheng had no choice but to contact manual customer service to end the order.

But now there was no way to sweep away a second bicycle in this quiet place. Time waited for no one, so she reluctantly took a taxi and rushed to the Nanlu Tea House.

Pan Li was more impatient than she imagined, and would send messages to urge her from time to time, for fear that this opportunity for an iron rice bowl would be lost.

Naturally, Tan Zheng couldn't let her down. The stage was set up and it was time for all parties to appear on stage.

The actors she found this time were one named Ni Hai, 45 years old, who played the role of the leader; another named Zhou Xiangyang, 25 years old, who played the role of her classmate; and a girl named Xiaojuan, who played the role of the tea sommelier.

"Hello teachers, I have sent you the general plot in advance. Just follow the above and act accordingly. You must always remember your character and don't show any flaws."

"No problem."

After a few simple greetings, Tan Zheng asked the actors to enter the private room first, while he waited outside.
